name: Volume Data Loading and Normalization
definition: A C++ class for loading 3D and 4D volume data from .npy files, normalizing values, and managing frame indices for time-varying volumes.
summary: Volume Data Loading and Normalization loads 3D or 4D volumetric data from NumPy files and normalizes values by subtracting the minimum, preserving absolute magnitude differences rather than scaling to a standard range.
